ModMetaData.name: Night Safety
ModMetaData.author: Valzietine
ModMetaData.description:
Night Safety turns nightfall into a survival problem.
Build and fuel a protection oven to project a circular safe zone. While the oven burns through the night, colonists inside its radius are shielded; step outside and the dark is no longer empty.
FEATURES - Protection Oven: a buildable, fuelable structure that creates a circular night safety zone while it has fuel. Its inspect panel shows the radius and current status (active, out of fuel, or inactive during daylight). - Forest Spirit: an automatically maintained, damage-immune presence that stalks pawns caught outside the safe zone at night and withdraws at dawn. - Night Harassers: small tribal packs that arrive under cover of darkness with one persisted theme: arson, bombardment, effigy building, or theft of outdoor stockpiles. They keep to outdoor objectives, flee when confronted, and retreat at dawn. They belong to a hidden, incident-only faction with no settlements, diplomacy, or raid presence. - Autonomous Safety: an opt-in per-pawn column on the Assign tab lets colonists return to a fueled safe zone on their own at night. Drafted, forced, downed, prisoner, and slave states are never overridden.
COMPATIBILITY Best-effort compatibility with RimWorld Together (nova.rimworldtogether). Map state is persisted and encounter ownership is kept deterministic so shared-map sessions stay consistent. The integration is soft: RimWorld Together is not required.
NOTES This release uses placeholder art for its buildings and the Forest Spirit. Load order is unrestricted; a soft loadAfter is declared for RimWorld Together so the optional compatibility hook applies after it when both are present.
